description: Protected golden baseline policy. Golden baselines under golden_directories are active acceptance assets: they must never be overwritten by automatic test side effects or by unguarded regeneration. Golden approval is out-of-band and non-automatable: unattended gates never accept agent-authored human:true, reviewer strings, or environment reviewer identity. Until a verifiable external attestation mechanism is provisioned, every golden change and every review-manifest entry is rejected as a finding. Generation tooling must refuse to overwrite active goldens in unattended mode.
